intro.text: В рассказе о прошлом работают четыре времени: Past Simple двигает сюжет, Past Continuous рисует фон, Past Perfect возвращает ещё дальше в прошлое, Past Perfect Continuous — о том, что длилось до момента.

cells: I opened the door and saw him.
It was raining and people were hurrying home.
I had been waiting for an hour.

practice.en: I [picked up] the phone and called her.
practice.ru: Я взял телефон и позвонил ей.

practice.en: The sun [was shining] and birds were singing.
When we arrived, the party [had] already finished.
practice.ru: Когда мы приехали, вечеринка уже закончилась.

practice.en: She was tired because she [had been working] all day.
practice.ru: Она устала, потому что работала весь день.
practice.why: Past Perfect Continuous — длилось до момента

practice.en: Everyone [was talking] when the teacher came in.

intro.text: В одной истории — все четыре времени. Посмотри, как каждое делает свою работу.

examples.en: It was a cold evening and snow was falling.
I had been walking for hours
examples.ru: Длилось до момента — Past Perfect Continuous

examples.en: when I finally saw a small hotel.
I knocked, and an old man opened the door.
He said that the last guest had left a week before.

intro.text: Связки держат порядок событий и подсказывают время.

cells: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
When I got home, I called her.
As soon as he saw me, he smiled.
By the time we arrived, the film had started.
In the end, we found the way.

practice.en: [While] we were walking, it started to rain.
[When] she saw the cake, she laughed.
practice.ru: Когда она увидела торт, она засмеялась.

practice.en: [As soon as] I got the news, I called you.
practice.ru: Как только я узнал новость, я тебе позвонил.

practice.en: [By the time] I woke up, everyone had left.
practice.ru: К тому времени, как я проснулся, все уже ушли.

practice.en: [In the end], we decided to stay at home.
practice.ru: В итоге мы решили остаться дома.

intro.text: О том, что бывало регулярно, рассказывают через used to и would: When I was a kid, I used to play outside all day. Would — только о действиях, не о состояниях.

rules.name: used to + глагол
rules.example: I used to live in Kazan.

rules.name: would + глагол
rules.example: Every summer we would go to the sea.

rules.name: Past Simple
rules.suffix: тоже можно, если ясно из контекста
rules.example: We went to the sea every summer.

practice.en: We [used to] live by the sea.
Every evening Grandpa [would] read us a story.
practice.ru: Каждый вечер дедушка читал нам сказку.
Раньше у меня были длинные волосы.

practice.en: On Sundays we [would] go fishing with Dad.
practice.ru: По воскресеньям мы ходили с папой на рыбалку.

intro.text: Самые частые ошибки в рассказах о прошлом.

errors.wrong: When I came, he already left.
errors.right: When I came, he had already left.

errors.wrong: While I cooked, the phone was ringing.
errors.right: While I was cooking, the phone rang.

errors.wrong: I was knowing him for years.
errors.right: I had known him for years.

errors.wrong: I would live in Kazan as a child.
errors.right: I used to live in Kazan as a child.

errors.wrong: At the end, we found the way.
errors.right: In the end, we found the way.
